home.title: Paper Lantern
home.subtitle: Understand Japanese letters in your language.
home.uploadButton: Upload a photo of a letter
home.dropzoneHint: Drag an image here or click to select
home.acceptedFormats: Photo up to 10 MB. JPEG, PNG and formats supported by this device.

upload.errorSize: Image must be 10 MB or smaller.
upload.errorType: Unsupported format. Please use JPEG or PNG.
upload.errorGeneric: Could not prepare this photo. Try a clear JPEG or PNG image.
upload.instructions: Choose a sharp photo showing the entire letter in good light. The preview stays on your device until you confirm sending it.
upload.choose: Take a photo or choose an image
upload.privacy: The photo will be sent to Google Gemini for analysis. In this test version, the free service may use the content to improve its products. Use fictional documents or remove names, addresses, personal numbers and other sensitive data before sending. Paper Lantern does not save the photo or explanation; leaving this screen discards them.
upload.consent: I confirm the photo contains no personal or sensitive data and authorize sending it to Google Gemini.

analysis.timeout: Analysis is taking longer than expected. Please try again.
analysis.errorApiNotConfigured: Image analysis is not available in this installation.
analysis.errorInvalidResponse: The model response could not be processed. Please try again.
analysis.errorIllegible: Could not read the image. Try taking a clearer photo with better lighting.
analysis.errorNotJapanese: This image does not appear to be a Japanese document.
analysis.errorGeneric: An unexpected error occurred. Please try again.
analysis.referencesWarning: The excerpts below were extracted by the model — verify important information directly on the letter.
analysis.referencesWarningDemo: The excerpts below are part of a fictional example — they do not represent a real document.
analysis.aiDisclaimer: Generated by AI — verify important information directly on the letter.
analysis.aiDisclaimerDemo: This is a fictional example created for demonstration — it is not a real document.
analysis.errorRateLimited: The analysis limit has been reached. Please wait and try again.
analysis.errorUnavailable: Could not connect to the analysis service. Check your connection and try again.
analysis.partialWarning: Some text is uncertain or unreadable. Check the original document before acting.

calendar.modalDescription: Review the extracted dates and correct them if needed before downloading.
calendar.dateUncertain: Uncertain date — please fill in before exporting
